sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Proprietary enzyme technology that preserves beta-glucans, combined with a unique, self-aware marketing voice that centers on climate activism.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Oatly Group AB is a Swedish food company that produces dairy alternatives from oats. Founded in the 1990s based on research from Lund University, the company uses patented enzyme technology to turn fiber-rich oats into liquid nutrition. It is widely credited with popularizing oat milk globally through its distinctive branding and expansion into coffee shops and retail.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Oat milk (Chilled/Ambient)
Barista Edition
Oatgurt
Ice Cream
Cold Brew Coffee.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Millennial/Gen Z consumers, vegans, lactose-intolerant individuals, specialty coffee shops (baristas).
